# Concept images: what exists and what is missing

<!-- Generated by `npm run previews:report` from src/config/previewImages.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

**4 of 40** orderable combinations (product × stitch × material × colour) have a concept image.
Customers who pick a missing combination see “No concept image yet for this combination” instead of a
picture of something else, and their order still records the exact options. Size is shown by the
dimensions, so one image covers both sizes unless a size-specific image is added.
